entities.name: Assadullah Sarwari
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Assadullah Sarwari is an Afghan former politician, former ambassador to the Mongolian People's Republic and convicted war criminal who belonged to the Khalq faction of the communist People's Democratic Party of Afghanistan (PDPA). He was born in Ghazni Province.
